exact: RNA polymerase II CTD repeat modifying activity
RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat modifying activity

definition: A catalytic activity that acts on the RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (consensus YSPTSPS). Reversible modifications cof the RNA polymerase II CTD repeats contribute to regulation of RNA polymerase activity.
label: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat modifying activity
